name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 3 Expanding Presence with Bing Places
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A quick win: set up Bing Places for Business, usually by importing the Google Business Profile.

# Key points
- Bing has roughly 6 to 7% of search share and is the default on many Microsoft devices; competition is lower.
- Import from GBP at bingplaces.com, then verify (PIN by mail or phone).
- Check that name, address, phone, website and categories match Google exactly; add missing photos.
- Update Bing whenever Google info changes.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- A low-effort item to confirm for each client (Bing also feeds Copilot answers, which the [AI SEO Masterclass](lib:brain-ai-seo-masterclass) links to B2B and Microsoft surfaces).
- Any listing change is Kim's or Scott's action, logged in the client hub.
